learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the correctness of programs, formally specify the required properties and proving them using various methods, particularly structural induction.
Gain knowledge of a particular formalization of recursive programs, proving their properties within a single logical theory Peano arithmetic.
Get hands-on experience with the specification and verification of a large number of programs.

syllabus_topics: Declarative Programming. Primitive recursion. Recursion with measure. Iterative recursion. Recursion on notation. Pairing function and arithmetization. Structural recursion.
Specification-verification System. Peano Arithmetic. Mathematical induction. Extensions of arithmetic. Derived induction principles: complete induction, measure induction, structural induction.

Data Structures. Strings. Lists. Basic operations over lists. Sorting of lists. Applications of lists. Binary trees. Basic operations over binary trees. Binary search trees. Applications of trees. Symbolic expressions. Interpreter of programming language. Universal function.
assessment_rules: Preliminary assessment accounts for 60% and the final exam for 40% of the grade. The grading scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%.
